name: Create and schedule social content
summary: Creates and schedules social posts: each planned post becomes an unpublished Instagram draft and its publish is queued for approval, and recent posts are read back. Crons read and draft; a person approves every publish.

all.evidence: 31 of 40 discovery calls describe how they make and post social content, and every step is manual

covered_by.idea-capture: skill (the owner or agent gives the idea)
covered_by.content-plan: skill (planned posts are written to the posts store)
covered_by.create-visual: skill (the picture is made by hand or in Canva, and needs an https link)
covered_by.write-caption: skill (caption written by the agent, checked before it is planned)
covered_by.approve: approval (a person approves each live publish in the CRM shell)
covered_by.respond: skill (replies to comments are judgment, not a cron)
covered_by.track-results: read (recent posts on Instagram and the Facebook Page)

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Planned posts to Instagram drafts; each publish queued for approval.

crons.name: track
crons.summary: Recent posts on each channel, kept for the owner's review (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: an Instagram container is not public until media_publish runs, and the reads change nothing. Anything that publishes a post is a live operation and waits for a person.

meta-ads.covers: Instagram single-image posts (container, then publish on approval), Facebook Page photo and text posts on approval, and reads of recent posts

gaps: LinkedIn organic posts (ugcPosts) are mapped, but LinkedIn requires the header X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0 and the kit cannot set a header on a call yet. No LinkedIn adapter until the kit gains per-operation headers (a core change).
Canva has design and export operations mapped but no publish step. The picture is made by hand or in Canva, and its https link goes into the post.
Hootsuite, Metricool and Vista Social were read, but none has an API operation mapped in the kit, so none has an adapter.
No container status check is mapped (Meta's status_code), so an approval can run before Instagram has finished processing a picture. If it fails, approve it again after a minute.
Only single Instagram images are built. Reels, carousels and stories are not built or verified.
Scheduled publishing is not built: approval publishes when approved. Facebook's scheduled_publish_time exists on the Page feed but is not wired.
Replies to comments (respond) are a judgment step for the agent. Instagram comment reply operations are mapped but are live, so no cron runs them.
Per-post insights are not read: the metric names need confirming against Meta's docs first. track reads recent posts only.
No command or CRM screen adds a planned post yet. The agent or owner writes it to the posts namespace until a form exists (tools/workflow.ts has propose, which is quoting-only).
The Meta token needs the Instagram publishing and Page posting permissions. Checked offline only, not against a real account.

evidence.calls: 40 content-posting calls were read: 31 describe the process, with manual share at 100 percent on most steps
evidence.platforms: the Hootsuite, Metricool and Vista Social help pages were read: none has a mapped API operation, so the kit adapter covers Meta only
